full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant in this rule is that: Defendant No. 3 as plaintiff filed a suit bearing Title Suit No. 226/80 for declaration of his title to the suit land in the court of Subordinate Judge, Noakhali and obtained an ex parte decree on 12.9.81 against the present opposite party Nos. 1-5 and others. The opposite parties Nos. 1-5 have filed a Title Suit No. 690/81 for declaration that the ex parte decree dated 12.9.81 of Title Suit No. 226/1980 is void. Before filing of the above declaratory suit No. 690 of 1981 the defendant No. 3 transferred the suit land to the present petitioner by a registered kabala. No. 5200 dated 12.3.82. The petitioner filed a petition under Order 22 Rule 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure before the Subordinate Judge, Noakhali on 1.12.90 for adding him as party to the suit. But the learned Subordinate Judge rejected the petition on the ground that the petitioner purchased the suit land after filing the suit and if he be added as party to the suit a serious complication may arise. Being aggrieved at this order the petitioner preferred this revisional application and obtained the Rule.
